parameters.query: WITH payload AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(policy_code text, category text, canonical_question text, answer_text text, paraphrases jsonb, conditions jsonb, effective_from date, effective_to date, version integer, source_title text, source_section text, owner text, approved boolean, sensitivity text, synthetic boolean)), upserted AS (INSERT INTO hr.policy_item (policy_code, category, canonical_question, answer_text, paraphrases, conditions, effective_from, effective_to, version, source_title, source_section, owner, approved, sensitivity, synthetic) SELECT policy_code, category, canonical_question, answer_text, paraphrases, conditions, effective_from, effective_to, version, source_title, source_section, owner, approved, sensitivity, synthetic FROM payload ON CONFLICT (policy_code) DO UPDATE SET category = EXCLUDED.category, canonical_question = EXCLUDED.canonical_question, answer_text = EXCLUDED.answer_text, paraphrases = EXCLUDED.paraphrases, conditions = EXCLUDED.conditions, effective_from = EXCLUDED.effective_from, effective_to = EXCLUDED.effective_to, version = EXCLUDED.version, source_title = EXCLUDED.source_title, source_section = EXCLUDED.source_section, owner = EXCLUDED.owner, approved = EXCLUDED.approved, sensitivity = EXCLUDED.sensitivity, synthetic = EXCLUDED.synthetic, updated_at = now() RETURNING policy_code) SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS upserted_count FROM upserted;

WITH scoped AS (SELECT * FROM hr.policy_item WHERE source_title = 'Sentetik İK Politikası' AND policy_code BETWEEN 'HR-001' AND 'HR-100'), category_counts AS (SELECT category, COUNT(*)::int AS total FROM scoped GROUP BY category) SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total_records, COUNT(DISTINCT policy_code)::int AS unique_policy_codes, COUNT(DISTINCT category)::int AS category_count, BOOL_AND(synthetic) AS all_synthetic, BOOL_AND(approved) AS all_approved, MIN(jsonb_array_length(paraphrases))::int AS min_paraphrases, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(category, total ORDER BY category) FROM category_counts), '{}'::jsonb) AS category_counts, (COUNT(*) = 100 AND COUNT(DISTINCT policy_code) = 100 AND COUNT(DISTINCT category) >= 15 AND BOOL_AND(synthetic) AND BOOL_AND(approved) AND MIN(jsonb_array_length(paraphrases)) >= 3) AS success, current_timestamp AS tested_at FROM scoped;
